propositions: Provider-prefixed model references (e.g., 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai-prices.calc_price as model_ref trigger LookupError because genai-prices expects bare model ids.

LookupError exceptions caught in usage_log._price_row:429 silently convert rows to unpriced without warning, causing Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows to drop from cost totals while Bedrock rows price correctly, creating asymmetric provider cost comparison bias.

The provider-aware id translation must use KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES registry membership rather than prefix splitting, because naive colon-split breaks versioned AWS ids like 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'.

Cost reporting in CI provider matrix and rebar usage output omits prices for Anthropic and OpenAI models despite genai-prices having pricing data, showing only Bedrock costs and biasing provider comparison.
The fix must preserve best-effort pricing policy (never break summarize) while making genuinely unknown models visibly distinguishable from mis-formatted ids in output.
